statement: After a formation-time operation-ledger self-move reaches terminal, the operation_workflow_owner (RebalanceCoordinator + OperationWorkflowOwner) admits and dispatches the pending priority control-plane ADDs under the EXISTING maxConcurrentAdds budget instead of one-per-lane-hold: the priority_add concurrent-create budget turn is released after persist and claim (physical dispatch of a DISPATCH_AFTER_CLAIM operation runs outside runConcurrentCreateBudgetGate), and racing siblings that observe an already-cleared held self-move in tryClearHeldOperationLedgerSelfMove are admitted instead of being refused as operation_ledger_self_move_in_flight, so the deterministic real-owner witness test/convergence/dt6-priority-recovery-add-dispatch-cadence.test.js shows every sibling still excluded while the self-move is in flight, no spurious refusal after the terminal, all priority ADDs acked within the contract bound (terminal + one retry cadence + one measured single-operation latency), and the joiners' startup authority READY inside the unchanged 60-second budget — with maxConcurrentAdds, CRITICAL_CHECK_DELAY_MS, the ledger interlock exclusion, the failed-repair backoff, and the single cluster-ACTIVE authority all unchanged. Root cause traced from GCP run 2026-08-29T19-08-22.423Z (active=2/5 at 93s; joiners degraded PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_PENDING for 63s while ADDs went out at 05.1/23.6/34.4/43.1/48.5).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The operation_workflow_owner (RebalanceCoordinator + OperationWorkflowOwner) stays the sole owner of create-budget admission, ledger-interlock admission, claim, and dispatch; no caller, rebalancer planner, harness, or readiness owner re-derives admission or dispatches around it.

maxConcurrentAdds, CRITICAL_CHECK_DELAY_MS and the other scheduler cadences, the 60-second GCP certification window, the operation-ledger self-move exclusion while in flight, and the failed-repair backoff are unchanged; the fix may only stop holding the create-budget turn through physical dispatch and stop refusing siblings that observe an already-cleared held self-move. No sleeps, timeout widening, retry widening, or readiness weakening.

Prove the cure through test/convergence/dt6-priority-recovery-add-dispatch-cadence.test.js on the real RebalanceCoordinator + OperationWorkflowOwner with a virtual clock (red on HEAD for the two mechanisms, green after) before any GCP run; the GCP streak is certification, never an iteration loop.
Do not make the harness, analyzer, or readiness owner derive cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage; joiner READY keeps its single startup-authority owner.
